definition: a small restaurant selling drinks and snacks
description: At small round tables on the pavement outside a city cafe, an older woman with white hair sits reading a book and sipping a cup of coffee. A young man in a colourful shirt at the next table talks at her, waves his hands, leans over her book and finally holds his phone in front of her, but she never looks up from her page. He slumps back in his chair while a waiter passes behind them.

en.question: What is the old woman doing?

de.answer: Sie liest in einem Café ein Buch.
de.question: Was macht die alte Frau?

es.answer: Está leyendo un libro en una cafetería.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la anciana?

fr.answer: Elle lit un livre dans un café.
fr.question: Que fait la vieille femme ?
